scenes.study: The study is hushed. An empty place on the display cushion makes the missing seal impossible to ignore. A desk holds paperwork that might reward closer inspection.
scenes.hall: The narrow hall connects the study to a side door. Footsteps would carry clearly through this passage, and the door offers a route out of the house.

porter.name: Porter Quill
porter.description: Porter Quill wears a neatly buttoned dark waistcoat. He stands close to the study doorway, with his hands folded in front of him.

maid.name: Maid Rosalind
maid.description: Maid Rosalind wears a practical apron over her work clothes. She keeps to the hall near the side door.
